instructions: Cut the core out of the radicchio and chop the leaves into bite-size pieces. Chop the endive the same way and coarsely chop the arugula.
Put the radicchio, endive and arugula in a large bowl and season with a pinch of the salt and pepper.
In a small bowl, whisk the Dijon, red wine vinegar and olive oil with the remaining salt and pepper.
Pour the dressing over the greens and toss until they are lightly coated.
Use a vegetable peeler to shave the Parmesan over the top and serve right away.
method_notes: None of the versions I could read had ratings (Food Network showed none, Flavor the Moments had 0 reviews), so Bobby Flay's is a fallback lead, chosen for the classic three greens, mustard and red wine vinegar dressing. Flavor the Moments uses the same greens with a plain red wine vinaigrette. Valerie Bertinelli adds fennel, shallot and lemon, which I left out. Chop and dress just before serving, because arugula wilts.
